entry.title: Retrolooper One (MPC) 0.3.9
entry.summary: ## Install the effect and Controls together Use the [combined MPC One+ ZIP](https://github.com/asearan/Retrolooper-One-MPC-Force/releases/download/mpc-v0.3.9/Retrolooper-Complete-MPC-One-Plus-0.3.9.zip) for the tested modified MPC One+ 3.10.0.49 host with root SSH access. It installs Retrolooper One 0.3.9 and experimental Controls 0.2.13 in one run. 1. Save your Akai project and unzip the download on your computer. 2. On Mac, open **Install on Mac.command**.
